raw: I remember taking a library book back years late. I was embarrassed just returning it, but what really sticks with me is the librarian unfolding my old checkout slip. Then there was the due date stamped inside the cover—an actual date, not just “a long time ago.” I kept thinking about how many years late it was. Funny how a little stamp can make you feel so embarrassed. I’m an amateur stargazer, so I’m used to thinking about long stretches of time, but that felt rather different when it was an overdue book.
